# Shaokun Lyu

**Researcher in Spatial Data Science, GeoAI, Urban Health, and AI for Science**

I work at the intersection of geospatial data science, machine learning, environmental sustainability, and population health.

My research focuses on understanding how environments shape human health and how AI can support scientific research.

## Research

### Spatial Data Science & GeoAI

Using machine learning, remote sensing, and geospatial data to understand complex spatial systems.

### Urban Environment & Health

Studying how built, natural, and perceived environments influence health outcomes and spatial inequality.

### AI for Scientific Research

Developing and evaluating AI agents for scientific reasoning, reproducibility, and machine learning research.
